row.proto: void Ne_AnimPacketB4_Sample(void *packet, void *binding, float time, void *out)
row.notes: Slot +0x18 (sample) of the NeAnimPacket_B4 vtable 0x1458a1780 and its only reference (cell 0x1458a1798); the packet factory 0x1443b5880 installs that vtable. Arguments as Ne_AnimPacketB1_Sample; the time is spilled to [rsp+0x2c]. Its per-track sampling is inline: vucomiss xmm0,xmm3 at 0x143a39f77, vcvttss2si r8d at 0x143a39f87, movzx eax,word [rax+rcx*2] at 0x143a3a00a. A track of 3 or more keys compares the time only with its first key (vucomiss; jae, not taken when unordered), turns (time - first key) * rate into a bucket index with vcvttss2si, passes the signed cmp/jle against the bucket count and reads the bucket table at that index: a time that is not a number or plus infinity gives 0x80000000 and reads 4 GB below the table. The lowest float takes the first-key exit (segment 0 at weight 0); a 2-key track clamps it to weight 0 with vmaxss; a 1-key track ignores the time. Core's anim packet time guard wraps it.

verify.notes: gh:anim-packet-time-blind Blind re-derivation on d873a1c8. Factory jump table 0x145a969c8: type 4 stores the vtable 0x1458a1780 (lea at 0x1443b63ac; NeAnimPacket_B4 sits just before it and slot +0x10 0x143a39d40 passes that name to 0x143a38180). It has 11 slots, so no +0x58, and only +0x18 reads a float register. Slot +0x18 = 0x143a39df0 (.pdata to 0x143a3a2f3), referenced only by the cell 0x1458a1798. rcx = packet, rdx = binding slot, xmm2 = time (spilled to [rsp+0x2c] at 0x143a39e5a), r9 = output. It writes 4 floats per track. For 3+ keys, vucomiss [desc+0x10],xmm3 at 0x143a39f77; jae 0x143a39fdb is not taken when unordered. vcvttss2si r8d at 0x143a39f87; signed cmp r10d,r8d; jle at 0x143a39f99; movzx eax,word [rax+rcx*2] at 0x143a3a00a with movsxd rcx,r8d. -FLT_MAX takes the jae: segment 0, weight 0 in xmm7, and the weight-0 test at 0x143a3a1a7 (or r15b=0 at 0x143a3a1d4) goes to the direct cubic and never reaches the solver 0x143a36380. 2-key: vmaxss with 0 gives weight 0 at segment 0, no time index; 1-key ignores the time. Large finite times with (time-first)*rate >= 2^31 give the same INT_MIN, so a guard that maps only non-finite values leaves that open. Same text and rip constants at Steam 26566308 0x143a3c3c0 (.tls$, vtable 0x1458a38f0 +0x18; read at 0x143a3c5da), EA 1.0.141 0x143a26e10 (.rdata, vtable 0x1459b29c0), EA 1.0.145 0x143a293e0 (.arch, vtable 0x1459b5b10). The pattern hits once in the whole file of all four, at 0x3a39dee/0x3a3c3be/0x3a26e0e/0x3a293de, = the hints; anchor 0x2.
